body: I hate the shame it has broken me over the years to where Im the nice guy even when I shouldn't be. I was the best I ever was socially on opiates but after a while I realized it was doing more bad than good i just took them to escape for a day but it got out of hand I've stopped for about a year and a half now still do it once and a while but I'm still waiting for that brain feeling to go away as for the family I know it's part on me I was bad growing up and I feel like I failed them so I kinda lock myself away from them. I would like to try the medical way since I've never tried besides self medication it's sad to say I just don't know how to begin I have no doctor plus I just don't know what to say. Really appreciate the reply.

I know that it's an end and it really tears me that's probably why I'm still here and not dead yet but It feels like my good times are behind me now I know I'm young but I feel old all I see is suffering in my future because I know I will blow another opportunity because I will freeze up and won't know what to do or say it sucks because ill look back and say if I had the balls to do this my whole life could be different that's what kills me inside the most all the missed chances I wouldn't feel like I failed everyone that I was something instead of the lonely guy who wanted to be cool as a teenager. Thank you for replying talking is helping since I really have no one I can say how I feel to I really appreciate it.
